description: PDF render metrics for the 454-page incident artifact. This shows how an unbounded pagination loop produced 454 pages when content was missing.

placedCharsByPage.description: Array of 454 elements showing character counts per page
pages_11_100: pattern: mostly 0-15 chars per page (mostly just page footer text: 'www.cosmictantra.chiti.tech' + page number)
pages_401_454: pattern: same near-empty tail; final pages contain only footer and possibly a single heading with no content

paginationControllerState.note: The legacy renderer did not use the PaginationController from src/lib/kundli/layoutEngine.ts. It had no maxPages enforcement, no stall detection, and no blank-page guard.

rendererBehavior.contentAfterCover: mostly empty: headings with no data, key-value pairs with empty values (e.g. 'Lagna: '), or undefined sections skipped
rendererBehavior.overflowBehavior: one oversized block wrapped past the right margin; the ~13-char header pushed every subsequent line onto a fresh page
